name: 5917-prefill2048-llama3-8b-4gpu
hardware: 4x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (sm90, NVLink) of one node.
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1 -- one in-process vLLM engine on one node.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, bound 125 requests, 1800 s safety cap, warmup the first 10% (head-only, 112 scored), no cooldown, static seed 5917.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn: prompt exactly 2048 tokens, output exactly 1 token, greedy, request_format plain (no chat template), streaming on.
purpose: A moderation tool where an 8B Llama model returns one-token verdicts on 2048-token documents, single-stream, across four GPUs.
launch:
# The engine command line: one vLLM engine spanning four H100s of one node, Llama-3-8B-Instruct
# in float16 with CUDA graphs off.
#
# vLLM 0.6.1-era AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction.
# Do not add keys from a later vLLM.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 4

# Not a default: this engine resolves the multi-GPU executor as "ray if ray is importable in the
# venv, else mp", which would make it a property of the environment rather than of the item.
distributed-executor-backend: mp

# The checkpoint's own torch_dtype is bfloat16, so vLLM casts on load and says so in the log.
dtype: float16

enforce-eager: true
max-model-len: 4096
max-num-batched-tokens: 4096
enable-chunked-prefill: false
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

error.text: its reference PR was closed unmerged and the setup depends on a component that no longer exists
